question: Spirogyra belongs to which group of plant kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thallophyta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Plants have diverse varieties.
 
• There are more than 3 lakh plant species that have already been found in the world.
 
• Plants are beneficial in human life they give food, and shelter and fulfill many other needs of various organisms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Kingdom plants are divided into five groups- Thallophytes, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms, and Angiosperms.

Thallophyta

 
• The plant body is not differentiated from roots, stems, and leaves.
 
• They are commonly called algae.

Bryophyta

 
• These are small terrestrial plants.
 
• They show differentiation in the body design, with stem, leaf-like structures, and root-like structures.

Pteridophyta

 
• The plant body is differentiated into roots, stems, and leaves, apart from having a specialized tissue for conduction.

Gymnosperms

 
• Gymnosperms are plants with naked seeds.

Angiosperms

 
• Angiosperms are seed-bearing plants. Seeds develop inside tissues that get modified to form the fruit of the plant.
